caption: The Quill, Oranjestad
composition: Lower Town waterfront looking inland at the volcanic cone · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the bay road in Lower Town the Quill is a broad vegetated cone above the roofs, dark against a mainly clear sky. Warm lamps light the small houses, and the bay edge sits in the foreground. It is about 28.8°C, with wind near 21.8 km/h and cloud cover about 45%. Fort Oranje is not in this frame, and the crater trail is not shown.
